name: Grudges
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers not to hold grudges or seek revenge but to love others as themselves, reflecting God's holiness and mercy (Leviticus 19:18). Love is shown to be the antidote to hatred, capable of covering all sins and preventing strife (Proverbs 10:12). Wisdom and discretion encourage believers to defer anger and graciously overlook offenses, which is honorable (Proverbs 19:11). Christ teaches that forgiveness is essential for receiving God's forgiveness, emphasizing that forgiving others is a necessary part of prayer and relationship with God (Matthew 6:14; Mark 11:25). The Golden Rule reminds us to treat others as we wish to be treated, promoting a heart free from grudges and full of grace (Luke 6:31).
